why.org_c:finding:06379: Enables the most likely internet-facing attack path to the crown-jewel warehouse via CVE-2024-21762 on amber-meadow-vpn-44.
why.org_c:finding:06380: Enables local privilege escalation to obtain an SSH key on amber-meadow-vpn-44, continuing the primary attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06374: Exposes larch-basalt-vpn-41 to internet exploitation leading to an alternate attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06378: Exposes amber-willow-vpn-43 to internet exploitation on a secondary attack path.
why.org_c:finding:06381: Exposes vireo-sol-vpn-45 to internet exploitation on another path to the crown jewels.
why.org_c:finding:06376: Exposes onyx-vane-vpn-42 to internet exploitation on an additional attack path.

reasoning: To protect the crown-jewel warehouse datastore, we must cut all attack paths originating from the internet. The minimum cut identifies five internet-facing vulnerability findings whose remediation completely severs all attacker routes to the target. Fixing these findings eliminates the initial entry points used in the multi-step attack paths.
